what: Running gap between the door's kick strip and the threshold
status_source: assumption: at least 3 mm so the door clears the threshold with hinge sag; at most 10 mm, the drop seal's travel until its datasheet is in (HOLD)
fix: Set the kick strip and threshold heights so the worst case stays inside the drop seal's range

joint: IF-01 IF-03 IF-04 IF-05 M6 bolt into a rivnut through a clearance hole
what: Radial clearance left for an M6 bolt after both hole positions and the rivnut's float (fixed-fastener case; the panel shifts to the bolts within the spigot play)
status_source: calculation: the bolt must enter without forcing (guideline section 6.3, worst case)
fix: Use a bigger clearance hole or a slot, or hold the hole positions and the locator tighter

joint: IF-03 and IF-04 back wall across its width
what: Slack left in the back wall's closed chain: side frame face, stop, B1, stop, B2, stop, side frame face. Below 0 the last panel won't seat on its stops; all slack lands in one seam, so above 0.125 that seam's gasket drops under 25% squeeze
status_source: calculation: gasket 3.18 squeezed to 2.26 + slack must stay at 25% or more, the register's target (joints register 2.2); at 0 the chain just closes
fix: Give the chain a place to take its tolerance (one seam without a hard stop, or a slotted corner), or hold the panels and the side-frame spacing to tolerances that keep the slack between 0 and 0.125
